messages:
incident-bot: Pager: billing-ingest token-count delta > 20% vs 1h baseline for last 8m. Likely duplicate ingestion after consumer-group rebalance. @oncall is paged.

oncall: acknowledging. brief: are customers seeing overage flags or invoice spikes?

jenna: billing-frontend shows ~1.1k transient overage flags created across multiple orgs in the last 12m. UI alerts started spiking around 1777007400.

eng-metrics: metric: ingest.consumer_lag spiked from 50 -> 1200 during a rebalance at 1777007350. We also saw multiple commit failures: `ERROR commit failed: OffsetOutOfRange`. Could be replays when consumers restarted.

billing-frontend: confirmed invoices generation job ran at 1777007460 and picked up the inflated tallies for some accounts. We have 72 invoices created in the window.

oncall: runbook: step 1) set incident severity P1; step 2) pause invoice emitter job; step 3) throttle ingest consumers.

deploy-bot: runbook action: paused job billing-invoice-emitter at 1777007505 (user: oncall).

jenna: throttling consumer group by reducing max.poll.records and scaling consumers down. issuing: `kafka-consumer-scale --group ingest-group --replicas 2`

eng-metrics: dedupe window is 120s in the pipeline; duplicates reingested after rebalance are arriving with new event_ids because the producer gave new UUIDs on reconnect. This bypasses de-dup logic.

billing-frontend: suggestion: run a reconciliation to identify events with same (account, minute_bucket, token_amount) fingerprints to collapse duplicates. starting dry-run.

jenna: starting recon dry-run: `./tools/billing_reconcile --since 1777007200 --mode=dryrun --out=/tmp/recon-1777.json` ETA ~8m.

eng-metrics: additional note: one of the ingest proxies returned 500s for ACKs for ~3m during peak; producer retried with backoff but created new UUID each attempt.

oncall: good. plan: 1) keep invoice emitter paused; 2) run dedupe with dry-run -> then non-dry to roll back inflated usage; 3) prepare customer comms for any invoices created; 4) postmortem owner assigned.

finance: if invoices already sent, recommend marking them DRAFT and suppressing emails until recon completes. i'll open a hold with billing ops.

billing-frontend: dry-run recon results: flagged ~9.8k events as probable duplicates affecting ~950 accounts. potential token reduction ~0.9% of daily tokens for those accounts. detailed CSV: /tmp/recon-1777.csv

jenna: applying dedupe now in forced mode: `./tools/billing_reconcile --since 1777007200 --mode=apply --confirm` (running).

deploy-bot: reconcile job started job_id=recon-1777007700. watch logs: `/var/log/recon/recon-1777007700.log`

eng-metrics: while recon runs i'll keep an eye on consumer lag and producer 5xx rates. consumer lag normalized after scaling; producer 5xxs subsided after a cache-layer restart at 1777007600.

billing-frontend: reconcile applied: removed 11,042 duplicate token events, suppressed 68 invoices (moved to HOLD). created ticket BIL-5703 for audit trail.

finance: HOLD placed; notifying customers with draft invoices suppressed. Customer impact limited: some customers saw transient UI spikes but no email invoices.

oncall: lowering severity to P2; monitoring for 30m. follow-ups: BIL-5703 (audit + communication), PMT-119 (postmortem) assigned to jenna + eng-metrics.

incident-bot: Incident moved to monitoring at 1777008050. Actions to follow: provider patch to producer retry behavior to reuse event ids on retry (ENG-PR-332), improved dedupe heuristics (ENG-PR-334), and runbook update to pause emitter when consumer_lag > 500 during rebalance.
